stemMd: Choose the version that correctly punctuates the nonessential description of one named person.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Omar, the team's captain welcomed the visitors.

options.label: B

options.label: C

explanationMd: The name already identifies Omar. The added description is nonessential and must be enclosed by a pair of commas.

distractorRationale.d: The nonessential phrase needs a matching opening comma.
distractorRationale.a: The nonessential phrase lacks a closing comma.
distractorRationale.c: The comma incorrectly separates the verb from its object.
